title: Zur Koordination im Russischen
summary: In the present work three Russian coordinating connectors are examined, which are very similar in at least one of their partial meanings: they can all be translated with German 'and'. For the connectors 'a' and 'da' in the dictionaries and grammars also a meaning 'but' is given. Another peculiarity of these lexemes is that they exist both as conjunction and as identical particles.
